acceptance_checks: Every record under the mirror's goals, tasks, ledger, dag, plans, runs, reports, worktrees and runner directories validates against its declared schema (today the majority fail).
Reintroducing a legacy-only pattern into any schema makes validate_shiki fail with a pattern-mismatch message.
A plan whose task declares a collision-resistant dependency id resolves against a registered task with that id; the legacy form still works.
A fresh target install followed by goal creation produces records that validate against the schemas installed beside them.
A ledger entry whose task_id belongs to a different goal than its goal_id fails validation; all existing entries still pass.

findings.detail: git diff main...HEAD carries the entire already-merged goal (contract mode, mergegate_check, dozens of .shiki records) because the branch was cut from a stale local main. MergeGate derives its base from origin/main where those commits already exist, so they resolve empty. The actual task change is the schema dual-pattern updates, shiki_tasks._TASK_ID_RE, validate_shiki's conformance loop + ledger pairing, and tests/test_mirror_schema_validation.py. Consistent with prior clean reviews in this goal; not a defect.
findings.title: Reviewable surface is small; rest of the diff is stale-local-base noise (informational)

findings.detail: validate_mirror_schema_conformance now runs every record in 9 mirror dirs through its schema. Whether all ~1000 real records conform field-by-field (esp. plans/runs/reports/runner) can't be proven from the diff alone. It is asserted by test_real_mirror_conforms_to_declared_schemas and by validate_shiki --target . in the task's test_command, and the loop runs only after the manual validators pass (short-circuit try) with additionalProperties:true schemas, so the main new enforcement is the id pattern — now dual and matching all real ids (verified 106/106 task files carry expected_branch and no legacy-only pattern remains). A gap would stop the loop with a red gate, not merge silently.
findings.title: Whole-mirror conformance is test-gated, not diff-verifiable (informational)

scope: Replace the legacy-only id pattern with the dual pattern already used by repair-packet and memory-entry schemas across the thirteen stale schemas and the two templates, and replace the legacy-only literal in the plan dependency parser with the shared id alternation. Add a loop to the contract-consistency validator that runs every mirror directory's records through the schema it declares, so schema/validator drift becomes a CI failure. Add the ledger task_id/goal_id pairing check using the task-to-goal map the validator already builds.
test_command: bash scripts/test_shiki_manifest.sh && bash scripts/test_shiki_evidence_integrity.sh && bash scripts/test_shiki_p2_schema_drift.sh && python3 scripts/validate_shiki.py --target . && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
title: Make the shipped contracts true, and validate the mirror against them
